title: 第017章 符文之威第018章 一切休想
content_zh:
锵！
天帝剑被叶炎紧握，这‘一剑冲天’武技顿时被其施展，剑光闪烁剑气凛然，一股肃杀之气随之弥漫。
这一剑彻底冲天而起，直接将齐长枪的所有防御斩破，随后更是落在了其头颅之上。
齐长枪面色苍白，他想要抗衡，但一切已是晚了。
剑落，他的头颅也横飞起来。
嘭！
一道声音响起，他再无生机。
至死他都没想明白，自己二重结丹境的修为竟是死在了一位凝气境修炼者的手中？
咻……
这时齐山神色凝重，他早有防备脚下一动直接向着山洞之外而去。
“追！”
叶炎神色一凝，喝出一声与紫焱石狮追了上去。
但刚刚踏出山洞，叶炎便听到一道道脚步声响起。
齐刀等人来了！
齐山见到齐家众人顿时松了一口气。
吼！
不过这时一道刺耳的声音却也随之响起，一股紫色的光芒向着此地迅速而来。
“紫焱石狮！”
齐刀等人牙齿紧咬，他们能够感受到这等灵兽的恐怖，虽未曾出现，单纯那声音便近乎于灵台境修炼者媲美。
“这小子似在山林长大，与这小紫焱石狮将齐长枪执事等人斩杀了！”齐山恶狠狠地道。

闻言，众人一怔。
至于齐刀眸子也是落在叶炎身上，纵有不甘心也只能看向花婆婆等人道：“走，快退！”
“差了一线！”看着齐家人离开，叶炎叹然一声。若是再快一分，便可将齐山诛杀。
不过如今他也不敢在此多待，他虽能够驾驭这小紫焱石狮，但若那真正的紫焱石狮而来他也只有死路一条了。
“小家伙，此次多亏你了，我已将与你的御兽符解开，你恢复自由了，不过我叶炎算是欠你一份情，他日若有机会相遇，我一定还你！”
话语落下，叶炎骤然一动，向着远处掠去。
哗！
而在叶炎离开后，苍云山脉内轰鸣不已。
灵器出世，引发了苍云城的太多修炼者争夺，也是引起了山林内灵兽的震动。
这一夜注定无法安宁。
不过叶炎如今已是在夜幕之下返回了叶家！
content_en:
Clang!
The Heavenly Emperor's Sword was held tightly by Ye Yan, and he immediately used the 'sword to the sky' martial skill. The sword light flashed with awe-inspiring sword aura, and a chilling aura filled the air.
This sword completely shot up into the sky, directly cutting through all the defenses of Qi Changqiang, and then landed on his head.
Qi Changqiang's face turned pale. He wanted to resist, but it was too late.
The sword fell and his head flew up.
Bang!
A voice sounded, and he was no longer alive.
Until his death, he never thought that his cultivation at the second level of Dan Formation Realm would actually die in the hands of a Qi Condensation Realm practitioner?
Phew...
At this time, Qishan's expression was solemn. He had already been on guard and moved his feet directly towards the outside of the cave.
"Chase!"
Ye Yan's expression condensed, he shouted and chased after the Ziyan Stone Lion.
But just as he stepped out of the cave, Ye Yan heard footsteps one after another.
Qi Dao and others are here!
Qi Shan breathed a sigh of relief when he saw everyone in the Qi family.
roar!
But at this moment, a harsh sound also sounded, and a purple light came quickly towards this place.
"Purple Flame Stone Lion!"
Qi Dao and others gritted their teeth. They could feel the terror of such spiritual beasts. Although they had not appeared, the sound alone was almost comparable to that of Lingtai realm practitioners.
"This kid seems to have grown up in the mountains and forests, and he and this little purple-flamed stone lion killed Deacon Qi Changqiang and others!" Qi Shan said fiercely.
Hearing this, everyone was startled.
As for Qi Dao, his eyes also fell on Ye Yan. Even though he was unwilling to do so, he could only look at Granny Hua and others and said: "Let's go, retreat quickly!"
"It's just a hair's breadth!" Ye Yan sighed as he watched the Qi family leave. If it were just one minute faster, Qi Shan could be killed.
But now he doesn't dare to stay here for too long. Although he can control this little purple-colored stone lion, if the real purple-colored stone lion comes, he will only die.
"Little guy, thanks to you this time, I have unlocked the beast-control talisman from you and you are free again. However, I, Ye Yan, owe you a debt of gratitude. If we have a chance to meet you in the future, I will definitely repay you!"
After finishing his words, Ye Yan suddenly moved and flew towards the distance.
Wow!
After Ye Yan left, the Cangyun Mountains roared.
The birth of the spiritual weapon caused many cultivators in Cangyun City to fight for it, and also caused a shock among the spiritual beasts in the mountain forest.
This night was destined to be restless.
But Ye Yan has now returned to the Ye family under night!
